newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Smooth start for TNT web site in Hong Kong.
newsitem.headline: Smooth start for TNT web site in Hong Kong.

text.p: TNT Express Worldwide said there has been a favourable reaction in Hong Kong to the company's Internet web site after its first week of operation, Hong Kong manager Bryan Chan has told Reuters.
'Web Tracker' is a tracking facility offering customers the ability to track up to 10 consignments at one time, he said.
The pro-active system enables customers to track packages from anywhere in the world and taps into Global link, TNT's information technology network linking every depot, Chan added.
"The system has had a smooth introduction and our customers like it," said Chan.

"It is more beneficial to ad hoc users. Volume shippers are not so keen on the new system because they already have other means of tracking shipments. We think it will be very popular and will quickly prove itself. There is no hiding place from the consumer for us with this system," Chan noted.
The TNT web site which also gives company information can be accessed at http: //www.tntew.com .
